D 23857
S.B.D. 385m. 10.32

Memo. No. 451.

Headquarters, Crime Branch,
July 22, 1932.

A letter has been received from Mr. Wong Kwong
Tou (黃光斗), Chief of the Metropolitan Public
Safety Bureau, Nanchang, stating that a petition
reporting the misappropriation of $11,000.00 in
Hankow notes by the original of the above photograph,
one Chang Kuo Toong (張國棟), has been received
from one Lieu Tseng Hwai (婁春暉), the manager
of the Chian Woo (謙和) Native Bank, Hankow.
The petition reads as follows:-

"The petitioner has established the
"Chien Woo Native Bank at Hankow for many years.
"One of our assistants named Chang Kuo Toong,
"aged 25 years, a native of Chi An (吉安),
"had been entrusted with money transactions,
"which work he had carried out without any
"failure. Unexpectedly he absconded on June 20
"after he having misappropriated $11,000.00 in
"Hankow notes, which amount he then had in his
"custody. .................... The
"petitioner earnestly asks that instructions
"be issued to arrest him and recover the stolen
"money, and offers a reward of one thousand
"dollars for his arrest."

Any information, please notify Headquarters,
Crime Branch.

K. H. Bourne
Deputy Commissioner (Crime)

备忘录第451号。

刑事处总部，
1932年7月22日。

收到南昌市公安局局长黄光斗（Wong Kwong Tou）来信，称汉口谦和钱庄经理婁春暉（Lieu Tseng Hwai）递交呈文，举报上述照片中人张国栋（Chang Kuo Toong）侵吞汉口钞票11,000.00元。呈文内容如下：-

“申请人于汉口开设谦和钱庄多年。
本庄一名助手名为张国栋，
年龄25岁，吉安人，
受委托经管银钱交易事务，
此前工作一直未出差错。不料其于6月20日
在侵吞由其保管的汉口钞票11,000.00元后潜逃。....................
申请人恳请发布指令将其逮捕并追回赃款，
并愿提供一千元赏金以资缉捕。”

如有任何线索，请通知刑事处总部。

K. H. Bourne
副警务处长（刑事）

July 16, 32.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No. 461 of July 7, enclosing ten copies of the
photograph of Chang Kuo Toong (張國棟), who abscond-
ed with $11,000.00, the monies of the Chien Woo Native
Bank, Hankow and to inform you that the matter is
receiving attention.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

Chief of Metropolitan
Public Safety Bureau,
Nanchang,
Kiangse.

逕复者接准
贵局七月七日法字第

汉口谦和钱庄钞洋一万

应函复希
查照为荷此致
江苏省会公安局局长黄
副警务处处长
兼刑事室主任包义
七月十六日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of a letter from Kiangse Metropolitan Public Safety Bureau
(Nanchang).
July 7, 1932.
No. “法” 461.

Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sirs,

I have the honour to inform you that on July
4, a petition reporting the misappropriation of $11,000.00
by an assistant has been received from a Lieu Tseng Hwai
(婁春輝), the manager of the Chien Woo (謙和)
Native Bank at Hankow. The petition reads as follows

"The petitioner has established the Chien Woo
Native Bank at Hankow for many years. One of
our assistants named Chang Kuo Toong (張國棟),
aged 25 years, a native of Chi An (吉安), had
been entrusted with money transactions, which
work he had carried out without any failure.
Unexpectedly he absconded on June 29 after he
having misappropriated $11,000.00 in Hankow notes,
which amount he then had in his custody. (Persons
have been sent to different places to locate him.
One man named Yu Zang Kang (余長庚) returned
from Kiukiang and said that he was told by a friend
named Bang Kai Ming (彭開明) that the absconded
assistant had gone to Kiukiang and had the intention
of proceeding to Nanchang. From the above informa-
tion obtained, Chang Kuo Toong may come to Nanchang.
The petitioner earnestly asks that instructions be
issued to arrest him and recover the stolen money,
and offers a reward of one thousand dollars for his
arrest."

Beside instructions have been given to the detective
branch and all Police Stations in this port to make secret
enquiries in order to locate and arrest the absconded
assistant, and as there is a possibility that he may proceed
to Shanghai, you are kindly requested to instruct all detectives
to make enquiries, trying to bring the said Chang Kuo Toong
to justice. Ten copies of the photograph of Chang Kuo Toong

（右侧手写批注：Photograph）
（左侧手写批注：Issue circular & acknowledge.）
（左侧印章：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : (CRIME BRANCH) JUL 16 1932）
（左侧手写批注：C.'s / please ask: / if received / memo. / A / 16/7/32）

刑事与特别股登记处。
编号 D 3857
1932年7月16日

上海公共租界工部局警务处
警务处长办公室。

江西省会公安局（南昌）来函译文。
1932年7月7日。
“法”字第461号。

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

敬启者：

兹荣幸告知，本局于7月4日收到汉口谦和（Chien Woo）钱庄经理婁春輝（Lieu Tseng Hwai）递交之呈文，举报一名助手侵吞款项11,000.00元。呈文内容如下：

“申请人于汉口开设谦和钱庄多年。本庄一名助手名为张国栋（Chang Kuo Toong），年龄25岁，吉安人，受委托经管银钱交易事务，此前工作一直未出差错。不料其于6月29日在侵吞由其保管的汉口钞票11,000.00元后潜逃。（已派人分赴各地查访其下落。一名名为余長庚（Yu Zang Kang）之人从九江返回，称其友彭開明（Bang Kai Ming）告知，该潜逃助手已前往九江，并有意前往南昌。根据上述获得之信息，张国栋可能会来南昌。申请人恳请发布指令将其逮捕并追回赃款，并愿提供一千元赏金以资缉捕。）”

此外，已指令本埠侦探科及各警察局进行秘密调查，以便 locate 并逮捕该潜逃助手。鉴于其有可能前往上海，特请阁下指令所有侦探进行调查，务求将所述之张国栋绳之以法。随函附上张国栋照片十张

（右侧手写批注：照片）
（左侧手写批注：发布通缉令并回复。）
（左侧印章：副警务处长：（刑事处）1932年7月16日）
（左侧手写批注：C.'s / 请问：/ 是否收到 / 备忘录 / A / 1932年7月16日）
